modelInput.question: Using a demand and supply diagram, explain the effect of the drought on the equilibrium price and quantity of wheat. [4 marks]
modelInput.answer: The smaller harvest reduces the wheat offered at each price. The supply curve moves from S to S′, while D stays fixed. The initial price p leaves excess demand, so the market price rises to p′. The new intersection has a smaller traded quantity q′ than q because consumers move up their unchanged demand curve. The higher price and lower quantity follow from the same supply contraction.
